scope: Offline supervised pretraining plus actual PPO fine-tuning of same11-input64x64 policy; analytic teacher is NOT deployed.
preserved: same11 channels through invertible linear conditioning
no extra queue/state/history input and no deployed predictor/planner
selection: Primary results use every final PPO-trained checkpoint. BC checkpoints are ablations, never silently relabelled PPO. No best-seed or per-scenario selection.
baselines: Equal teacher corpus/pretraining/architecture/PPO budget for newly trained PPO; also preserve original stronger PPO, original fast LQR, matched robust LQR and declared MPC. No optimal-MPC or universal superiority claim.
guard: All existing scenario outcomes are development evidence. This new test runs after all six policies finish and is not used for retuning.
